```llp
%% I go to {R}.
go [dyn] : at(L) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o at(L2).
```

```llp
%% I open {R}.
open_closed [dyn] : $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * closed(R) -o opened(R) * checked(R).
```

```llp
%% I take {O} from {R}.
take_plain [dyn] : $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree -o holds(O) * holding.
```

```llp
%% I put {O} in {R}.
put_plain [dyn] : $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * holds(O) * holding -o inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree.
```

```llp
%% I walk over to {R}.
go [dyn] : at(L) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o at(L2).
```
